name: Large sets with distinct subset products
description: construct() -> 1..18 distinct integers in 2..40. All 2^k subset products, including the empty product one, must be distinct. Exact arbitrary-precision products are enumerated. Maximize number of selected integers. The local instance restricts N=40 and certificate cardinality to 18 to bound exhaustive verification. It supplies finite constructions, not the paper’s asymptotic theorem. Integer one is excluded because it collides with the empty product.
